correctness.rationale: The supplied exhaustive chain verifier enumerates all 262144 masks and finds 18 vertices and face vector (1,18,108,264,252,72). The integral integer-boundary cancellation certificate contains precisely 341 signed unit pivots (17,91,173,60 in degrees 2–5) and leaves only zero differentials with remaining ranks (1,0,0,19,12). The one-skeleton has a 17-edge spanning tree and every 91 nontree edge generators is killed by triangular relators in five verified rounds, so pi_1=0; H_2=0 implies pi_2=0. The 3-skeleton is then a wedge of 3-spheres and the 4-cell degree matrix has only unit and zero Smith factors, yielding the claimed wedge of nineteen 3-spheres and twelve 4-spheres. The second verifier independently reproduces all face counts and four-prime ranks; this is a finite object so exhaustive search is a complete certificate.

value.rationale: K_{3,3} is the canonical smallest balanced cubic complete bipartite utility graph, and replacing all nine edges by opposite directed arcs produces a natural strongly connected graph outside the one-way bipartite and bidirected-path/cycle families treated in foundational papers. Its multipath complex has two different nontrivial sphere dimensions, and the exact integral homotopy classification goes substantially beyond Euler or finite-field homology. The nontrivial 341-step integral reduction and direct pi_1 check make this a meaningful first benchmark for the untouched bidirected complete-bipartite setting. No general K_{m,n} theorem is claimed.
